name: cavemio-citation
title: Citation
description: An inline numbered source that previews the site, title and snippet on hover or focus.

cavemio.usage:
import { Citation } from "@/components/citation";

Highlights style text without touching the DOM
cavemio.accessibility:
- The marker is a real link, so middle-click and Ctrl-click work, and it’s labelled "Source 1: title".
- The card is a tooltip linked with aria-describedby; it opens on keyboard focus and closes on Escape.
- Short open and close delays stop cards flickering as the pointer crosses a paragraph.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: index
props.description: – · The number shown in the marker.

props.name: source
props.description: – · What the card shows. icon takes a favicon element; a globe is shown without one.

props.name: status
props.description: "available" · Unavailable (or no source) strikes the marker and explains in the card.

features.title: A marker in the sentence
features.description: A small numbered marker that sits on the text’s baseline, where the claim is.

features.title: A preview of the source
features.description: Hover or focus it to see the site, the title and a snippet.

features.title: It stays on screen
features.description: The card flips above near the bottom of the screen and shifts to stay inside it.

features.title: It opens the source
features.description: The marker is a real link, so middle-click and Ctrl-click work.

features.title: Broken sources say so
features.description: A source that couldn’t be fetched is struck through and the card explains it.

features.title: No flicker
features.description: Short open and close delays stop cards flashing as the pointer crosses a paragraph. Escape closes it.

states.title: closed
states.description: A quiet numbered marker that sits on the text’s baseline.

states.title: open
states.description: After a short hover delay, or at once on focus: site, title and a snippet. The card rises 4px out of a 2px blur (220ms) and sinks back the same way when it closes (140ms).

states.title: unavailable
states.description: The marker is struck through and the card says the source couldn’t be loaded.
